rationale: Both Li Yang and Bodhi Korolov work at the intersection of telecom infrastructure and research — Li Yang as a research scientist at Nokia in telecom-research, and Bodhi as a Group Product Manager at Spectralink focused on voice and communication infrastructure. Their complementary perspectives (research depth vs. product leadership) could surface valuable insights on how infrastructure research translates to real-world communication systems.
intro_message: Li Yang, meet Bodhi Korolov — you both work in telecom infrastructure from different angles (research at Nokia vs. product leadership at Spectralink) and could compare notes on where research priorities meet market needs.
